scope: Kernel priority 1: fused CSR residual and weighted Jacobi sweep connected to persistent AMG/FEM solves

implementation.layout: four lanes per row, 64 rows per 256-thread block; immutable old iterate and distinct output
implementation.integration: Backend optional native hook; AMG uses existing ax scratch and swaps buffers after each successful sweep
implementation.default: disabled; existing small-level cooperative smoother takes precedence if both options enabled
implementation.failure: shape/coefficient/stream checks before launch; checked CSR accesses propagate malformed rows/columns as NaNs; launch failures propagate without publishing a successful preconditioner result

benchmark_method.command: SONIUM_REQUIRE_CUDA=1 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 cargo test -p sonium-fem --features cuda --lib native_fused_jacobi_solve_benchmark -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
benchmark_method.baseline: cuSPARSE preprocessing enabled in both modes; existing SpMV plus native Jacobi update versus fused CSR step; cooperative small-level smoother disabled in both
benchmark_method.controls: identical hierarchy/damping/sweeps, zero-start FGMRES, independent residual and discrete-solution error gates, equal iteration counts
benchmark_method.sampling: two warm sweeps, nine measured three-frequency sweeps per mode, alternating mode order; 264 solves per run including warmup
benchmark_method.timed_window: warm numeric update plus solve and synchronization; setup/reference/output download excluded
benchmark_method.isolation: builds and CPU tests finished; older sanitizer suspended via EXIT-trap wrapper and resumed after each run

limitations: Four small 2D Helmholtz cases on one GPU; larger matrices, other row distributions and physics need separate measurements.
One repeat showed nonstationarity for the largest case; no samples were removed. Stable first/confirmation runs show about 1.05-1.10x improvement.
Not a comparison against every possible smoother or combined small-level policy.
Chebyshev arithmetic is unchanged; opt-in fused Jacobi is used only where Jacobi smoothing is selected.
No universal default promotion or complete CUDA coverage claim.
